headline: Malaysia's DNeX Stock Surges 13% Following 255% Q3 Net Profit Growth
summary: Shares of Dagang NeXchange Berhad jumped 13% after the Malaysian technology and energy firm reported a 255% surge in Q3 net profit to RM42.63 million.
why: Dagang NeXchange Berhad (DNeX) is a technology and energy provider listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia.

impacts.name: Dagang NeXchange Berhad
impacts.why: DNeX shares jumped 13% after Q3 net profit surged 255%.
